map.Barthel指数评估日常生活活动能力（ADL），10个项目评分（0-100分）: The Barthel Index assesses activities of daily living (ADL) across 10 items (0-100); higher scores mean greater independence. Click options to auto-score.
map.本健康工具基于通用生理常数与经验公式估算，结果仅供参考，不替代专业医疗诊断与建议: This health tool estimates from common physiological constants and empirical formulas; for reference only, not a substitute for professional medical diagnosis. Tool: Barthel Index (ADL) Grader.
map.患者日常生活完全独立，无需他人帮助: Patient is fully independent in daily life, needing no help
map.100分：完全自理 → 独立完成所有ADL: 100: fully independent -> completes all ADL independently
map.75-95分：轻度功能缺陷 → 大部分自理，需少量帮助: 75-95: mild deficit -> mostly independent, little help
map.50-70分：中度功能缺陷 → 需较多帮助才能完成ADL: 50-70: moderate deficit -> needs substantial help for ADL
map.25-45分：重度功能缺陷 → 大部分ADL需他人帮助: 25-45: severe deficit -> most ADL need assistance
map.0-20分：完全依赖 → 所有ADL完全依赖他人: 0-20: fully dependent -> all ADL rely on others
map.脑卒中康复期每两周复评，对比指数变化判断康复进展与出院准备度。: Reassess every two weeks in stroke rehab; compare index changes to judge recovery and discharge readiness.
map.骨科术后患者转移与行走项评分低，据此安排助行器与陪护强度。: Orthopedic post-op patients score low on transfer and walking; arrange walkers and supervision accordingly.
map.长护险或照护等级申请，按总分 0–100 分级（≤40 为重度依赖）。: For long-term care insurance or care-level applications, grade by total 0-100 (<=40 is severe dependency).
map.复核一例卒中患者 Barthel 评分: Review a stroke patient Barthel score
map.患者进食 5 分、洗澡 0 分、转移 10 分、行走 10 分，十项合计 45: Patient: feeding 5, bathing 0, transfer 10, walking 10; ten items total 45, moderate dependency, matching rehab assessment.
map.本工具能替代康复评定报告吗？: Can this tool replace the rehab assessment report?
map.不能，仅作条目核对，正式评定由康复师结合临床整体判断。: No; it only checks items. Formal assessment is by the therapist with overall clinical judgment.
map.认知障碍患者如何评分？: How to score cognitively impaired patients?
map.以实际完成度为准，需他人全程协助的条目计 0 分，避免高估。: Score by actual completion; items needing full assistance count 0, avoid overestimation.
map.分值波动大说明什么？: What does large score fluctuation mean?
map.提示功能不稳定或评测时机不同，建议固定时段、同一评估者复评比对。: It suggests unstable function or varying timing; reassess at fixed times by the same rater for comparison.
map.按 Barthel 十项 ADL 评分量化自理能力，辅助康复进展与照护等级判定。: Quantifies self-care by ten Barthel ADL items to aid rehab progress and care-level decisions.
